summary: The note describes Desnianskyi District, an administrative raion (district or borough) of Kiev, the capital of Ukraine. It lies in the north-eastern part of the city on the Left Bank of the Dnieper River. The note says it is the most populous district of Kiev and the second largest by total area, which it gives as ca. 14.8 ha.
one_line: Desnianskyi District is an administrative raion in the north-eastern part of Kiev, Ukraine, on the Left Bank of the Dnieper River.
key_facts: Desnianskyi District is an administrative raion (district or borough) of the city of Kiev.
Kiev is the capital of Ukraine.
Desnianskyi District is located in the north-eastern part of Kiev.
Desnianskyi District is located on the Left Bank of the Dnieper River.
Desnianskyi District is the most populous district of Kiev.
Desnianskyi District is the second largest district of Kiev.
The total area of Desnianskyi District is given as ca. 14.8 ha.
The note's page title is "Desnianskyi District, Kiev" and it is sourced from Wikipedia.
